_provenance.authored_by: A-data, spec 130, 2026-09-19, by hand from the page's rule below
_provenance.page_rule_verbatim: This fee schedule applies to FX pairs (EUR/USD), stablecoins in the base currency (USDT/USD, DAI/USDT, etc.) and pegged tokens (TBTC/BTC, WBTC/BTC, etc.). If the stablecoin is the quote currency only (BTC/DAI), the fee schedule in the "Spot Crypto" tab applies.
_provenance.page_rule_source: kraken_fee_schedule_2026-09-19.html.gz, the 'Stablecoin, Pegged Token & FX Pairs' tab
_provenance.declared: DECLARED. Which of the page's tables applies to each archive USD pair, decided from the page's own rule. The schedule is Kraken's in force on 2026-09-19, applied to a 2023-24 window. Never read by the live or paper path.
_provenance.use: REPORTING ONLY (lead decision D8, 2026-09-19). The replay serves the Spot Crypto tier to every pair, findings section 7's documented substitute, because the fee contract (FeeTierSnapshot) is account-level. This list says which pairs would fall under the other table, so a run can report how many candidates and trades landed on them. No client reads it to price anything.
not_mapped_here: Which row of the stablecoin_pegged_fx table a spot tier corresponds to. Moot: the replay never serves that table.
